name: Sealed Note to Elling
summary: Jorgen sends a sealed dispatch through Stormwind to Elling Trias, the proprietor of Trias' Cheese. The fisherman’s message draws Trias into a quiet inquiry about a vanished diplomat.

sections.title: A Quiet Hand-Off
sections.body: Jorgen gives a strict charge for the sealed note in Stormwind: place it in Elling Trias's hands and keep silent. The stakes leave no room for careless talk. Trias runs a cheese shop in the Trade District, where Jorgen's message brings the inquiry into the diplomat's disappearance to his counter.

faq.q: What is written inside the sealed note?
faq.answer: The note stays sealed until it reaches Elling Trias. It carries Jorgen's report and directs the courier to Trias for further inquiries into the diplomat's disappearance.

faq.q: Why does a cheese vendor receive secret intelligence?
faq.answer: Elling Trias runs an unassuming cheese shop in the Trade District as a public front. Beneath that appearance, he has an extensive underground network of ears and eyes across the city, making him valuable in delicate investigations.
Jorgen is a fisherman found down by the water in Stormwind's Valley of Heroes. He has some history with Elling Trias and Bishop DeLavey, who calls on him for discreet matters kept from prying eyes.

faq.q: What is the missing diplomat case about?
faq.answer: A Stormwind diplomat sent to Theramore to meet Jaina Proudmoore never arrived. Royal authorities quietly investigate every suspicious lead to avoid causing panic in the streets.

angles.text: As a rogue familiar with Stormwind's shadow networks, you may recognize Elling Trias as more than a cheese merchant. This discreet correspondence fits the work of those networks.
As an Alliance member, you carry Jorgen's message in service to the Crown, helping advance an investigation vital to Stormwind's political stability.
